title: Main dashboard JS: unwrap GET /api/dashboard response envelope (success/data/error)
summary: Controller::json() normalizes all /api/* responses to { success, data, error }. dashboard/index.js was feeding the full object to renderDashboard(), so d.profile and d.structure were undefined despite valid API payloads under data. Added unwrapApiPayload (aligned with grievance/dashboard.js) to pass resp.data into renderDashboard and reject on success false.

items: unwrapApiPayload(resp) mirrors grievance dashboard: if envelope present and success false return null; else return resp.data or legacy unwrapped resp
fetchData .then chain rejects when payload is null so catch path still applies
